outcome: Recurrent preterm birth (PTB) in a subsequent singleton pregnancy
Gestational age at subsequent singleton delivery
Proportion of low-birth weight infants (<2500 g) in subsequent singleton delivery
cohort: The study included women with a history of spontaneous preterm trichorionic triplet delivery or spontaneous preterm dichorionic twin delivery (control group), all of whom had a subsequent singleton pregnancy during 2006-2017.
finding: Women with prior spontaneous preterm triplet delivery had a significantly lower rate of recurrent preterm birth (5.9%) in a subsequent singleton pregnancy compared to women with prior spontaneous preterm twin delivery (25.0%).
birth_weight: Low-birth weight infants (<2500 g) were measured as an outcome in subsequent singleton pregnancies.
gest_age: Index pregnancies were characterized by spontaneous preterm triplet or twin delivery; gestational age at subsequent singleton delivery was measured as an outcome.
